title: Claude Code remixed Godot’s MIT Pong demo; the browser export broke even though local testing passed
author: biggdogg420

comments.author: biggdogg420
comments.body:
Small follow-up: a separate game is live now: Commons Relay, a Codex-authored solo capture-and-hold fork of Ancient Beast. Built with AI assistance; Freezing Moon is credited, code is AGPL-3.0, and art is CC BY-SA. The deployed page reaches round one: https://game-commons-captain.thabiggdogg420.chatgpt.site/remix?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=community&utm_campaign=beta&utm_content=vision

For other creators: if you have a complete or unfinished game with full source and clear reuse rights for code and assets, share its public repo/release plus one next remix goal via guest feedback: https://game-commons-captain.thabiggdogg420.chatgpt.site/feedback?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=community&utm_campaign=beta&utm_content=vision. Playing, downloading and guest feedback require no sign-in. Direct uploads currently support only MIT self-contained HTML up to 2 MB and require creator sign-in; larger repos are suggestions for curation, not hosted builds.

What open game would make an interesting next starting point?
